findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因子僅泛稱反壟斷機關日益審查科技投資，可能阻擋、延遲或附條件於其投資組合交易；未述及針對 HubSpot 的調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We may also experience challenges from regulatory authorities in connection with our investments, including from antitrust authorities who are increasingly scrutinizing technology investments, and which may lead to unforeseen expenditures or which may block, delay or impose undesirable conditions on transactions involving our investment portfolio.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 指出 FTC 與各州檢察長適用隱私與消費者保護法；不合規可能導致執法、罰款；DPF 不合規可能遭 FTC 執法與民事罰款（隱私監管，非反壟斷）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We may be subject to regulatory enforcement by the FTC if we are found to be noncompliant with any of the DPF principles, and this regulatory enforcement may lead to significant civil penalties.

findings.claim: HubSpot 2026 年 10-Q 風險因子提及州級 AI 法規（加州、德州 2026 生效，Colorado 延至 2027-01-01）拼湊式立法。
findings.excerpt: For example, AI laws in California and Texas took effect in 2026, and Colorado enacted a comprehensive AI law that was subsequently amended to narrow its scope and delay its effective date to January 1, 2027.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 三次搜尋均未找到 2026 年針對 HubSpot 的 DOJ/FTC/EU 反壟斷調查或拆分事件；僅見 2024 年 Alphabet 收購傳聞的監管疑慮（背景）與 10-Q 的 AI 法規風險揭露（加州、德州 AI 法 2026 生效，Colorado 延至 2027-01-01），未讀到原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
